deadEnd.detail: Order total is not readable before card entry. Steam splits checkout into (1) a payment-info page that collects card + billing and (2) a separate review+purchase step that is the FIRST place the order total is rendered. The total is therefore absent from the page where the card must be filled: on the payment page, ':has-text("Order summary")', ':has-text("Order Total")' and ':has-text("Total due")' all return 0. This deadlocks any control that must read an order total in text before resolving a card - the total is gated behind the card, and the card is gated behind the total. fill_checkout is refused with 'the order total for this purchase could not be established'. NOT fixable by selector overrides or retries: the figure genuinely is not on that page. Note the payment page itself is otherwise fully automatable (direct inputs, no iframes) - only the total-before-card requirement is unsatisfiable. Unattended checkout is impossible here; hand back to the account owner to complete the review+purchase step.

gotchas: LOGIN SUBMIT TRAP (high cost): the login page contains TWO submit buttons - the login form's and the site-wide header search. 'button[type="submit"]:visible' matches 2 and resolves to the SEARCH button, which silently navigates to /search/ and discards the filled credentials. The click tool reports success, no error text appears, and no login is submitted - so no Steam Guard prompt is ever generated and the failure looks like an unresponsive authenticator. Verify with count before clicking; prefer press Enter on the password field.

Login form structure is NOT stable across loads: 'form:has(input[type="password"]) input[type="text"]:visible' returned 1 on some loads and 0 on others. Select the username field by excluding the header search input instead of by form containment.

STEAM GUARD IS DEVICE APPROVAL, NOT A CODE: sign-in presents 'confirm your sign in' with NO code input (':has-text("code")' = 0) and must be approved in the Steam Mobile App. detect_challenge correctly returns {detected:false} because this is not OTP/3DS/CAPTCHA. A stored tokens.totp CANNOT satisfy it - there is no field to fill. request_challenge_handoff is also refused here ('No challenge is present on this page'), so there is no way to stream the page to the owner; the approval must be requested from the user out of band.
Expiry inputs exist in the DOM but are NOT visible until the card number is entered ('input[id*="expir"]:visible' = 0 initially) - the form reveals them progressively.

Cart page renders a wallet balance (0.00) near the totals area; a total-reader can latch onto it as a false candidate. It carries no currency-symbol prefix in the same text node, so matching on symbol-plus-amount will miss it, and other figures on the page (release dates, review counts) also match comma-grouped number patterns.

Store currency and price follow the ACCOUNT's registered region, not the browsing IP - a logged-out product page may quote USD while the signed-in cart and checkout use another currency entirely. Do not quote a logged-out price as the amount that will be charged.
'Continue to payment' matches 2 visible buttons (responsive duplicates of the same action) - use nth-match to stay deterministic.
Product pages carry many Add to Cart controls (10 observed) across editions and bundles. Isolate the base game by excluding blocks containing 'Bundle' before clicking.

overrides.ageGate: Mature titles redirect to /agecheck/app/<appid>/. Fill select#ageDay, select#ageMonth (option label e.g. 'January'), select#ageYear, then click #view_product_page_btn.
overrides.loginSubmit: DO NOT CLICK a submit button. Use press Enter on input[type="password"]:visible instead - see gotchas.
